python3 - <<'PY'
p='src/codegen/lower_inst/builtins/io/stream_file_ops.rs'
s=open(p).read()
# fwrite: use the nullable resolver so a boxed null means "no cap"
assert s.count('resolve_int_operand_to_result(ctx, length, "fwrite length")?;')==2
s=s.replace('resolve_int_operand_to_result(ctx, length, "fwrite length")?;',
            'resolve_nullable_int_operand_to_result(ctx, length, "fwrite length")?;')
# fgets: same family — php's null length is unbounded, not a refused 0
assert s.count('resolve_int_operand_to_result(ctx, length, "fgets length")?;')==1
s=s.replace('resolve_int_operand_to_result(ctx, length, "fgets length")?;',
            'resolve_nullable_int_operand_to_result(ctx, length, "fgets length")?;')
open(p,'w').write(s)
print("switched to the nullable resolver")
